rationale: The matched pair establishes the inflation trigger, but the randomized end state contains one more element: after re-decision, nodes 1, 2 and 5 report decided equal to accepted 38 with index 36 still empty and the marker at 37. This revision extends the covering witness with a Decide for the inflated index and records the state afterwards, so the deterministic case can be compared directly with the randomized end state. If the hole persists once decided catches up with accepted, the deterministic case reproduces the run-13 shape exactly.

experiment.revision_reason: Extends acceptsync_covering_stopsign_inflates_accepted with a Decide for the inflated index 4 and an after_decide event recording accepted, decided, is_reconfigured and the entry kinds at indices 2 and 3. The covering AcceptSync, the before_sync and after_sync events and all other tests are unchanged.

scope.description: Five OmniPaxos instances. Node 1 is made leader, appends entries 1 and 2 with full delivery, then reconfigures so every node accepts entries 1..2 and the StopSign. Node 5 is moved to Prepare under ballot 2 and receives an AcceptSync whose log_sync has sync_idx 3, an empty suffix and the StopSign, inflating the accepted index. It then receives a Decide for that inflated index on the same ballot with the next sequence number.
assumptions: A Decide with the same ballot and the next sequence number is the message a leader would send once the inflated index is chosen.
If decided catches up with accepted while index 2 stays empty and the marker sits at 3, the deterministic case matches the randomized end state's shape.
No snapshots or trimming are involved.
excluded: Randomized loss, leadership churn, the next configuration being started, snapshots and flexible quorums.

experiment.prefix: The test acceptsync_covering_stopsign_inflates_accepted builds five nodes, makes node 1 leader, appends Value(1) and Value(2), reconfigures to configuration_id 2 and settles. It emits before_sync, sends node 5 a Prepare for ballot {config_id 1, n 2, priority 0, pid 9} and an AcceptSync with sequence counter 1, decided_idx 3 and a LogSync with sync_idx 3, empty suffix and the StopSign, then emits after_sync. New in this revision: it sends a Decide with the same ballot, sequence counter 2 and decided_idx 4, then emits after_decide with accepted, decided, is_reconfigured and the entry kinds at indices 2 and 3.

comparisons.description: After the inflated index is decided, the accepted index remains the inflated value while the readable log still has the hole, matching the randomized end state's shape.
